# cato_mailing_lists (Data Source)

The `cato_mailing_lists` data source fetches information about account mailing lists with optional filters. Returns a list of mailing lists matching the filter criteria.

## Example Usage

```terraform
## Providers ###
provider "cato" {
  baseurl    = "https://api.catonetworks.com/api/v1/graphql2"
  token      = var.cato_token
  account_id = var.account_id
}

### Data Source Usage ###

# Example: Read all mailing lists
data "cato_mailing_lists" "all" {}

# Example: Read mailing lists by name
data "cato_mailing_lists" "by_name" {
  name_filter = ["All Admins", "Security Team"]
}

# Example: Read mailing lists by ID
data "cato_mailing_lists" "by_id" {
  id_filter = ["12345", "67890"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id_filter` (List of String) List of mailing list IDs to filter by
- `name_filter` (List of String) List of mailing list names to filter by

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) List of mailing lists matching the filter criteria (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `address` (List of String) Email addresses belonging to the mailing list
- `admin` (Attributes List) Administrators of the mailing list (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--admin))
- `id` (String) Mailing list ID
- `name` (String) Mailing list name
- `type` (String) Mailing list address type, e.g. SPECIFIC_EMAILS

<a id="nestedatt--items--admin"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.admin`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Admin ID
- `name` (String) Admin name
